blocks.text: Another Filipino talent is making a mark on the global music scene, as Filipino-American writer Mark Hoying secured a nomination in the Best Children’s Music Album category at the 69th Grammy Awards. Mark earned the nomination along with his husband, Pentatonix singer Scott Hoying, for their album “Little Birdie’s Big Symphony.” “WHAT A DREAM. THANK YOU GRAMMYS!” Scott exclaimed in an Instagram post shared on Wednesday, Nov. 18. Scott spoke about how their album is their “love letter” to their daughter, Birdie. “Something people don’t always see is how long the road to parenthood can be for queer couples. For us it […]...
